BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund III Company Profile ( Free Report ) BlackRock MuniYield Quality Fund III, Inc NYSE: MYI is a closed-end investment company that seeks to provide current income exempt from regular U.S. federal income tax. The fund invests primarily in a portfolio of municipal bonds and other municipal obligations issued by states, cities, counties, and related public entities.

The fund generally focuses on investment-grade municipal securities, although it may also invest in lower-rated obligations when permitted by its investment policies.
